retained_lexical_reading: Dhatu code10.0481 is literal-final-a छद (SLP1 Cada), Curadi, अपवारणे; the final अ is retained lexical material, not an anubandha. Follow the adanta reading attested in Kshiratarangini entry321 and the1938 Siddhantakaumudi printed p.238. This is distinct from10.0370 Cada~ and10.0062 Cadi~.
